name: Cable Single-Arm Triceps Kickback
steps: Face a low cable, hold its handle in one hand and hinge forward with your elbow bent beside your ribs.
Straighten the working arm behind you while keeping the upper arm level with your torso.
Bend your elbow and guide the handle forward.
Switch sides and repeat the movement.
tips: Hold your shoulder still as your forearm moves.
Keep your spine neutral and avoid swinging the handle back with momentum.
